title: Philippines Retail Loyalty Personalization
thesis: Snowflake turns daily activity from aggregate loyalty segments of a fictional Philippine omnichannel retailer into clean-offer and opt-out KPIs, 7-day member opt-out risk scores, ignore rate anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on one governed platform.

talking_points: Clean offer rate, offer issues raised, member opt-outs and offer-attributed sales in PHP for 40 aggregate loyalty segments in Pasig City, Mandaue City, General Santos City, Zamboanga City and Angeles City.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it traces back to segment-day rows; there are no member-level records.
The issue-type chart shows which offer issues end in opt-outs and which always resolve, such as the two city-wide SMS gateway outages.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of personalization KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which segments are about to tune us out?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each segment's probability of a member opt-out in the next 7 days, from ignore rate, contact frequency, recent opt-outs, tenure and category affinity.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags ignore rate outliers per segment, and the forecast projects program-wide offer issues for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are our offer controls keeping up?

talking_points: Offer refresh compliance, consent record coverage and pending consent batches frame the control gaps.
Creative refresh compliance against member opt-outs by segment shows where stale creative and opt-outs move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, segment, issue-type and risk tables only.
show: Offer refresh compliance and consent coverage
Creative refresh compliance vs member opt-outs
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a campaign goes wrong right now?

talking_points: Live offer events land in RAW.LIVE_OFFER_EVENTS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ISSUE events with an SOP hint and the segment's current risk band, then emails the on-call CRM analyst.
tabs.call_out: From offer issue to CRM case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic offer-issue handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
